senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גנב)theft, the stolen object; deception.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:3">B. Kam. X, 3</cite> <he>ויצא לו שם ג׳ בעיר</he> and the report of his being robbed had spread in town.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:8">Ib. 8</cite> did not know <he>בגְנֵיבָתוֹ</he> that it had been stolen.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:8:7">Y. Sot. III, end, 19ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ אחת</he> one theft; <cite ref="Kiddushin 18a:9">Kidd. 18ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 18a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>גְּנֵיבוֹ אלף</he> if what he has stolen is worth one thousand (Shekel &c.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="C01136"><he>גְּנֵיבוֹת</he></cite>, <he>גְּנֵבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 18a:11">Ib.</cite>—Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 13 <he>גנב שלש ג׳ וכ׳</he> he committed three frauds &c., v. <cite ref="C01078"><he>גָּנַב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite>; a. fr.
